description: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc. One page.

tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form header, e.g. 2025

tax_period_beginning.description: Tax year beginning date as printed, MM/DD/YYYY

tax_period_ending.description: Tax year ending date as printed, MM/DD/YYYY

final_k1.description: True if the Final K-1 box at the top is checked

amended_k1.description: True if the Amended K-1 box at the top is checked

partnership.description: Part I, Information About the Partnership

ein.description: Item A, partnership's employer identification number, as NN-NNNNNNN

name.description: Item B, the partnership's name (first line only)

address.description: Item B, the partnership's street address, city, state and ZIP, as printed after the name

irs_center.description: Item C, IRS center where the partnership filed its return

publicly_traded.description: Item D, true if the publicly traded partnership (PTP) box is checked

partner.description: Part II, Information About the Partner

tin.description: Item E, partner's SSN or TIN

name.description: Item F, the partner's name (first line only)

address.description: Item F, the partner's address as printed after the name

partner_type.description: Item G, which box is checked: 'general_partner_or_llc_member_manager' or 'limited_partner_or_other_llc_member'

domestic_or_foreign.description: Item H1, which box is checked: 'domestic' or 'foreign'

entity_type.description: Item I1, the type of entity this partner is, as printed, e.g. INDIVIDUAL

retirement_plan.description: Item I2, true if the retirement plan box is checked

share_percentages.description: Item J, partner's share of profit, loss and capital, as percentages (10 for 10%)

profit_beginning.description: Profit share, beginning. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

profit_ending.description: Profit share, ending. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

loss_beginning.description: Loss share, beginning. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

loss_ending.description: Loss share, ending. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

capital_beginning.description: Capital share, beginning. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

capital_ending.description: Capital share, ending. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

liabilities.description: Item K1, partner's share of liabilities

nonrecourse_beginning.description: Nonrecourse, beginning column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

nonrecourse_ending.description: Nonrecourse, ending column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

qualified_nonrecourse_beginning.description: Qualified nonrecourse financing, beginning column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

qualified_nonrecourse_ending.description: Qualified nonrecourse financing, ending column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

recourse_beginning.description: Recourse, beginning column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

recourse_ending.description: Recourse, ending column. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

capital_account.description: Item L, Partner's Capital Account Analysis

beginning.description: Beginning capital account. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

contributed.description: Capital contributed during the year. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

current_year_net_income.description: Current year net income (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

other_increase_decrease.description: Other increase (decrease). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

withdrawals_and_distributions.description: Withdrawals and distributions, as a positive number even though printed in parentheses. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

ending.description: Ending capital account. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

contributed_property_with_builtin_gain.description: Item M, true if Yes is checked, false if No is checked

ordinary_business_income.description: Box 1, ordinary business income (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

net_rental_real_estate_income.description: Box 2, net rental real estate income (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

other_net_rental_income.description: Box 3, other net rental income (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

guaranteed_payments_services.description: Box 4a, guaranteed payments for services. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

guaranteed_payments_capital.description: Box 4b, guaranteed payments for capital. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

total_guaranteed_payments.description: Box 4c, total guaranteed payments. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

interest_income.description: Box 5, interest income. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

ordinary_dividends.description: Box 6a, ordinary dividends. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

qualified_dividends.description: Box 6b, qualified dividends. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

royalties.description: Box 7, royalties. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

net_short_term_capital_gain.description: Box 8, net short-term capital gain (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

net_long_term_capital_gain.description: Box 9a, net long-term capital gain (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

net_section_1231_gain.description: Box 10, net section 1231 gain (loss). A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

other_income.description: Box 11, other income (loss). One entry per code letter and amount pair printed in this box; empty if the box is blank

items.description: A code letter and its amount, read from the same row of the box

code.description: The code letter printed at the left of the row, e.g. A

amount.description: The amount printed on the same row as this code. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

section_179_deduction.description: Box 12, section 179 deduction. A number without commas or currency symbols; null if the line is blank

other_deductions.description: Box 13, other deductions. One entry per code letter and amount pair printed in this box; empty if the box is blank
